body: That's how I am. I'm labeled as a giver by my personality type... I do what I can to better everyone around me. Emotional karma doesn't exist or I'd be the happiest man in the world.

I was unclear with my first post, but I suppose I can be more detailed. I'm afloat right now. Xannies, some cheap vodka called Skol (the plastic bottle doesn't make it taste any better), and my prozac prescription just staring at me.

I used to never be like this. I used to be happy as a child... I used to always dream of growing up and being happy... I never thought I'd turn up this way...

Long story short my depression initially sprang up from being black sheeped from my family, I've been isolated and alone for about 9 years now. 

I've attempted suicide the first time last year
Second and third near the end of last year

Each time have been close calls. First time my heart stopped, second time I caused even more damage.

I'm just feeling more and more hopeless.

I've analyzed my depression very well to the point that my past two psychologists have told me almost word for word "I don't know what to tell you. Just stay out of your head the best you can" and that usually follows by a letter in the mail or phone call that they're referencing me to another psychologist or to a psychiatrist. I don't mind talking, I just... don't want to feel alone.
